summary: The original Orig1s000 review documents for the 2008 Vimpat (lacosamide) approval under NDA022253 (SumR, CDTL, MedR, etc.) are NOT present in paperclip; the only NDA022253 documents available are the 2008 label, a 2019 approval letter and 2018 label for later supplements, and the 2017 pediatric-supplement (S-039) review documents. No advisory committee could be established for the original 2008 approval because its review documents are unavailable. The only advisory-committee statement found anywhere in the available documents is in the S-039 pediatric-supplement CDTL review (T. Buracchio, Nov 2, 2017), whose 'Advisory Committee Meeting' section states 'None required' — this applies to the pediatric supplement, not to the original 2008 approval, so no AdComm or linkages can be documented from the available record.
